prompt: Vertical 9:16 night photograph of a huge model-railway diorama on a warehouse floor, seen from a low, level camera. Rows of tiny grey English terraced houses, thousands of them, laid out in four rectangular blocks. Front left, one small cluster of houses lit cold fluorescent teal from a single overhead tube: the homeless households. Behind it, two long blocks of dark, unlit houses. Beyond those, a fourth block the same size again where every tiny window glows warm amber with a lamp left on, curtains half drawn, no figures anywhere. The teal cluster looks small now, roughly a quarter of everything else. Shot on CineStill 800T, 35mm lens, visible grain, halation round the windows, slightly underexposed, dust on the model roofs. Thanks.
